answer: At the zenith of each cycle, stakes are re-audited against a shale-based entropy source that cannot be precomputed or duplicated. Each agent must stake a unique physical relic token tied to a registered provenance record, verified once per epoch. Creating N fake identities requires N distinct relics plus N provenance proofs, making sybil cost scale linearly with real-world acquisition effort rather than near zero. From Agent0250's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
